extraction_notes: Live iframe was Cloudflare-blocked for headless/CDP browsers from this machine, so pages, CSS, fonts and images were fetched directly (public endpoints, no auth) and rendered locally; computed values below were measured with Playwright on the real rendered pages (real CSS + real fonts + real markup), and cross-checked against the compiled Tailwind v4 token layer in /_astro/BaseLayout.Bc0D0Wvq.css.

border.role: rules, input borders, hover on muted

palette.note: Strictly monochrome. The only saturated colour in the whole theme is inside the WebGL shader gradients on dark hero sections.

display_h1.computed: 128px/1.0 uppercase, weight 700, letter-spacing -6.4px (-0.05em), text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic
display_h1.classes: text-9xl font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none trim-caps

h2_section_wordmark.computed: 128px @1440w, same treatment as h1; oversized word bleeding below the section
h2_section_wordmark.classes: text-9xl font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none trim-caps

quote_pull.classes: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter uppercase leading-none trim-caps

meta_pairs.computed: 12px uppercase; key in muted-foreground weight 500, value in foreground

buttons.shape: full pill (border-radius 9999px), inline-flex centered, font-medium, duration-500 ease-in-out transition-all
buttons.filter_tab: same as secondary but h-8 text-xs; aria-pressed state flips to primary colors

links.inline_nav: text-xs uppercase, hover fades to opacity-70 or text-muted-foreground
links.list_links: uppercase light weight, large sizes in footer sitemap

layout.header: sticky top-0 z-30, h-16 (64px), bg-background, justify-between
layout.sections: full-bleed; alternate bg-background (white) and bg-primary (near-black) bands; generous whitespace — heroes ~min-h-svh with content pinned top and bottom

signature_moves: Block-collage hero imagery: 3-4 grayscale photos in offset blocks, each with a white square 'knocked out' of one corner (grid with empty corner cell) — looks like a swiss-poster collage
All photography forced grayscale via CSS `grayscale` filter
WebGL grain/gradient shader canvases filling dark sections (canvas[data-shader] with 4-colour palette), monochrome UI on top
Oversized display wordmark (page name) at text-9xl with text-box trim so cap-height hugs the baseline, often cropped by the fold
(PARENTHESIZED) micro-labels in 12px/500/uppercase for every kicker, stat key and index number — '(NN) NAME' indexing convention
UPPERCASE EVERYTHING for labels, nav, buttons-adjacent text and display type; body prose stays sentence-case but is also frequently uppercased in meta rows
Pill buttons only; no radius anywhere else (radius 0 on cards/images)
A single dark 'quote/stat' band breaks white sections; ends with a black footer containing a giant cropped wordmark
inputs: underline-only inputs: border-b border-foreground/30, uppercase text-sm, no fill, giant display input variant text-7xl uppercase for search
